title: Polynomial Runtime Bound
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, define its polynomial runtime bound to be $2^{170}$ times the one-hundredth power of its runtime scale.
hypotheses_covered: The input's small-bias parameters have positive dimension and numerator, with twice the numerator at most the denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the runtime scale, so the quantity in this formula cannot be identified more precisely.
